changes.title: Veteran's Intuition description
changes.text: Veteran's Intuition rank +1 now describes the existing 2x armor identification speed. Its identification behavior is unchanged.

changes.title: Speedy Stealth description
changes.text: Speedy Stealth rank +1 now describes its existing conditions: invisible momentum gains apply while freerunning is inactive and off cooldown, up to 10 stacks.

changes.title: Provoked Anger duration description
changes.text: Provoked Anger now describes its existing 5-turn duration and the additional 5 turns granted by another shield break.

changes.title: Lingering Magic duration description
changes.text: Lingering Magic now describes its existing 5-turn duration and how another wand or staff zap refreshes that duration.

changes.title: Seer Shot branch visibility
changes.text: Seer Shot used through a thrown weapon now binds its revealed area to the current dungeon branch, so its reveal works on alternate branches as intended.
